debug_history: Attempt 1: -mavx2 in CFLAGS — GCC auto-vectoriser emitted AVX2 instructions, triple-fault on VAIO (no AVX2 silicon)
Attempt 2: -msse4.2 -mavx2 — same fault, auto-vectoriser still emitting YMM ops
Attempt 3: -msse4.2 -fno-tree-vectorize, removed -mavx2 — intrinsic body compiles but crash persists inside PMADDUBSW loop
Attempt 4: forced scalar dispatch in sam_int8_dot() — PASS. Confirms stack layout, serial output, and dispatch all correct.
Root cause: PMADDUBSW (_mm_maddubs_epi16) requires MXCSR to be properly initialised; bare-metal boot.asm does not set MXCSR. SSE4.2 intrinsic path deferred until MXCSR init added to boot.asm.
